versions.changelog: fix: replace empty visual fallback with scene number + keyword chips
fix: critical CSS brace escaping bug that broke all 8 layout styles
fix: polish template UI, fix GSAP selector scoping and visual fallback

Redesign template system: 8 distinct layouts (hero_center, split_full, timeline_flow, stats_grid, testimonial_card, step_flow, banner_announce, split_grid), 16 templates (6 new: cinematic_hero, split_showcase, step_by_step, metrics_dashboard, social_card, announcement), no content duplication, adapted GSAP animations
Fix user style override (palette/font now respected), add GSAP hard kill after exit animations for seek safety, document style parameter in SKILL.md
Fix scene transition jitter: hide all scenes initially, use fromTo for explicit control, align animations to data-start, fix _scale_frames to always compute start/end times
Add multi-language support: Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Thai. Improve sentence splitting and phrase extraction for non-Latin scripts.
Fix Chinese text support: add _extract_chinese_phrases, update _slug_words fallback, improve _brief_sentences for Chinese punctuation, deduplicate visual panel words

hyperframes-video-studio 1.0.5

- Added stricter HTML output requirements: generated HTML must not include empty placeholder media boxes, generic placeholder headlines, or bottom keyword chips vulnerable to player control clipping.
- Extended the video generation interface with an optional frame_contents property, allowing explicit per-frame headlines and captions to be set in advance (not just via automatic brief extraction).
- Updated documentation to clarify new HTML requirements and tool schema changes.

Fix generated HTML to conform to HyperFrames composition rules: root data-composition-id, clip classes, data-start/data-duration/data-track-index, registered paused GSAP timelines, no data-end/runtime polling. Verified all 10 built-in templates with hyperframes lint: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Update metadata and documentation to point to the official HeyGen Hyperframes repository: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes. Clarify that this is a community OpenClaw Skill built on top of the official Hyperframes project.

Add explicit Hyperframes CLI install guidance and a safe local installer/checker script. The skill now checks Hyperframes availability, asks for confirmation, installs only into .cache/npm, and avoids sudo/global PATH changes.

Fix renderability gap: generate Hyperframes-ready HTML project directories with relative assets, clarify JSON as manifest only, add dependency checks and psutil fallback, improve TTS path/provider handling.
Initial ClawHub.ai release with 10 guided video templates, safe asset intake, environment audit, local-first TTS routing, and Hyperframes JSON generation.
